title: The Broken TTL + LRU Cache
description: Feature flags go stale, hot entries disappear, and false-valued flags are repeatedly fetched.
objective: Reproduce the reported failures and repair the implementation without changing its public interfaces.
expectedBehavior: Flag is variant<bool,int,string>; optional<Flag> nullopt is a cache miss. get refreshes recency only, put refreshes TTL and recency. Expire at expires <= clock(). size counts live entries. Updating a key must not evict a different key. Fetch only on misses, including when stored value is false, zero or empty string.
constraints: Use the C++17 standard library and supplied read-only helpers only.
Do not change read-only files or tests.
